label: Qwen-Image-2.1 T2I 1024
prompt: A warehouse robot folds a blue cloth on a clean workbench.
notes: Replaces the two-GPU Qwen-Image-2512 rows (retired 2026-10-10). guidance_scale 1.0 means no CFG, so CFG parallelism has nothing to split; the multi-GPU choice is sequence vs tensor parallelism, which this repo has measured to be model-dependent (2512: Ulysses won by 4.7%; flux1/zimage: TP won). Pick sglang's profile with scripts/tune_sglang_serve_args.sh on the first B200/H200 box before publishing. VALIDATION PENDING (2026-10-10 round): derived, not yet measured.

gb300-2gpu-tp2.notes: 2026-10-10 GB300 served, NUMA-bound workers (sglang#43565), median of 5 x2 rounds: TP2 eager 1.728/1.731 s vs Ulysses-2 eager 2.778/2.776 s vs Ulysses-2 compile 1.918 s (sglang#43586); vLLM-Omni --usp 2 on 2 GPUs 3.21 s default / 2.85-2.98 s eager. 2026-10-22: extended to b300, the same Blackwell Ultra GPU (sm103) as GB300 on an x86 host; the GB300 measurement is the evidence, and the 4xB300 round re-measures it. 4xB300 A/B 2026-10-22: 1.465/1.466 s against b200-2gpu-ulysses-fa 1.769/1.797 s, so B300 keeps TP2.

cand-bcg.description: Breakable CUDA graphs captured at the served 1024x1024. Never selected on its own: A/B arm.
cand-bcg.notes: Derived from `gb300-2gpu-tp2` (the profile B300 selects). Audit 2026-10-23 (image sglang-side): Qwen-Image-2.1 BCG replays across prompt lengths since sglang#43633 (in 82f7249c) and was +1.9% on 2xH200 TP2, -0.5% on 1xH200; never measured on B300. The served size is 1024x1024, so that is the one warmup resolution. Grep the server log for '[Diffusion BCG] captured' and for MISSED replays. TP2 keeps the SP world size 1 the Qwen-2.1 padder needs. VALIDATION PENDING (wave 4, 4xB300).

cand-a2a-permute.description: blackwell-cudnn-static plus --ulysses-a2a-permute (copy-engine Ulysses exchange). Never selected on its own: A/B arm.
cand-a2a-permute.notes: vLLM-Omni #9922 (2026-11-13): Ulysses all-to-all over the CUDA copy engine instead of NCCL, off by default (`--ulysses-a2a-permute`). Upstream reports Qwen-Image SP2 1536^2 10.717 -> 10.467 s (-2.34%) and 512^2 5.524 -> 5.506 s on L20X, against its own earlier LSA kernel, pixel hashes identical. Round 1, one 4xB300 box, 2026-11-19 (vLLM-Omni 24e5472849, single_e2e medians, selected profile -> cand-a2a-permute): Qwen-Image-2.1 2 GPUs 1.435 -> 1.385 s (-3.5%); FastH3 V2 7.785 -> 7.338 (-5.7%); MiniMax-H3 4 GPUs 36.613 -> 34.779 (-5.0%); Wan2.2 97.710 -> 94.642 (-3.1%). sglang on the same box: 1.311 / 5.040 / 31.530 / 88.967 s. Second round pending.

cand-tetp2.description: blackwell-cudnn-static plus --text-encoder-tp-size 2 (text encoder sharded across the two DiT ranks, #9438). Never selected on its own: A/B arm.
cand-tetp2.notes: vLLM-Omni's text-encoder tensor parallelism (docs/user_guide/diffusion/parallelism/tensor_parallel.md) is off by default (text_encoder_tp_size 1) and documented for the Qwen-Image family and MiniMax-H3; its example pairs it with --tensor-parallel-size, this profile's DiT runs --usp 2. Round 1, one 4xB300 box, 2026-11-19: blackwell-cudnn-static 1.424 s, cand-tetp2 1.434 s. No gain. Not promoted.

lightx2v.reason: No validated two-GPU LightX2V command for Qwen-Image-2.1 yet (its upstream configs for this model are single-GPU) (2026-10-10).

trtllm-visual.reason: TensorRT-LLM VisualGen carries a Qwen-Image pipeline (tensorrt_llm/_torch/visual_gen/models/qwen_image/) but nothing for the 2.1 architecture: a code search for QwenImage21 / Qwen-Image-2.1 over NVIDIA/TensorRT-LLM returns no hits, and the model is absent from pipeline_registry.py. Qwen-Image-2.1 is a distinct architecture (QwenImage21Pipeline / QwenImage21Transformer2DModel / AutoencoderKLQwenImage21 / Qwen3-VL encoder), so the existing Qwen-Image pipeline does not cover it.

comfyui.reason: ComfyUI's only multi-GPU path splits CFG branches, and this case runs without CFG, so a two-GPU cell would be its one-GPU cell.

fastvideo.reason: No Qwen-Image pipeline in FastVideo main (2b164405c3d1, 2026-10-07).
